description: The Microsoft Windows Next Generation Cryptographic algorithm implementation provides enhanced support for AES, DRBG, DSA, ECDSA, RSA, HMAC, KAS, KDF, and SHS (SHA). All implementations are packaged into a library used by Microsoft and other third-party applications.
